title: Close scalar first-step integrability under a narrower analytical gate
statement: For scalar raw lambda-Lipschitz h with lambda<1/(2sqrt(3)), the explicit joint-source chain converges in Gaussian W1,4 and gives a positive initial correction with L2 symmetric Stein residual<=5lambda^4/[1-2sqrt(3)lambda]^2. A SUPPLIED separable basis extends the Frobenius bound with sqrt(d).

requires: Scalar source or supplied separable coordinates with independent source/noise pairs
Canonical resolvent and nonlocal OU expectations as analysis fields
provides: Hermite fourth moments give summability when A sqrt(3)<1
Truncations have explicit first-step linear-residual tails
assumptions: No higher modulus of h prime assumed
Corrected coefficients need not satisfy the next initial gate
costs: No finite g-only evaluation of chain supplied
Full law still requires paid reserve
Degree64/80 Galerkin failures and uncertified OU-grid diagnostics remain failures/diagnostics
